```sh
# Paste a real connection URL generated by the Svarog web interface.
export SVAROG_CONN_STRING='PASTE_GENERATED_CONNECTION_URL'

printf '%s\n' '{"message":"Hello from Java","timestamp":"2026-11-16T10:00:00.123456789Z"}' \
  | go run ./cmd/svarog-bridge
```
